caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by four black strings attached to its hands, head, and legs. The puppet has long black hair, a pronounced nose, and a serious facial expression with stylized red lips and dark eyebrows. It wears a red headband and is dressed in loose pince-nez style garments consisting of a red vest over a green shirt with wide sleeves, a black sash or belt around the waist, blue and white accents near the knees, and green puffy pants. The puppet's right leg is light green, while the left is red below the knee, and both feet are pointed. The left hand holds a bundle of brown and yellow reeds or wheat-like stalks. The name "Elmer Weise" is printed in black in the lower left corner of the drawing on a plain beige or off-white background.
title: Fan Dancer Marionette
